name: game-unsaved-edits
goal: Keep unsaved authored game edits and generated image references when navigation is canceled

evidence: Navigating away from a dirty real game loses title edits and generated image references; canceled navigation and reload must keep the document.

Standard game-authoring saved-graph and native creation matrix saved before navigating. Extend their shared lifecycle to cancel back-navigation and reload while dirty, including after image generation.
Immutable red record at 993ceb6af: the existing saved-graph flow cannot observe a discard confirmation and loses the edited document.
Guard dirty real game navigation with SvelteKit beforeNavigate; canceling either the app confirmation or native unload prompt keeps the document mounted.
Immutable paired proof 993ceb6af to 7ab19e6bd preserves the same tests and environment: dirty navigation and reload can be canceled, saved data reopens, and historical edits remain blocked.
